notes.title: I made another game and its on SALE this summer!!!
notes.notes:
I recently developed a new game that will soon be a Multiplayer title. You can Play the Singleplayer Battles gamemode right now and once the Online Multiplayer Closed Beta ends, grab your friends and get ready to go goblin mode. The multiplayer will be very different from the singleplayer experience; Decorate your own custom mine, buy weapons and battle your friends while you decide what multiplayer Arena Game you want to play. 

I really appreciate all the support as it allows me to keep doing what I am doing :)
Buying my game is the best way to support me as I am a solo developer and "Goblins" is a game that will continue to grow!!!

Steam Link To Download: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2301630/Goblins/]Goblins Steam Store Page[/url]


Regards,
NeonWizardGames

notes.title: Looking for a new game? Check out "Goblins"
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42083873/6ba2944311d19c028f3ec368f6cee0115d03a8ac.png[/img]

[b]Basic Summary[/b]
Command the Emerald Goblin Army and defeat the Ruby Goblins, winning the Great Gold War. Master Battles through 20 unique and increasingly difficult Campaign maps. Challenge yourself further in Freeplay Battles. And enjoy fun Mini-Games alone or with friends(Multiplayer-ComingSoon).

[b]Developer Message[/b]
Goblins is currently in a live build state. So every week new things will be added to the game as well as bug fixes for when things eventually break. I will be creating new content that I hope my friends and I enjoy playing. I'd like to add a fairly expansive multiplayer arena mode for lobby based matchmaking(similar to the scale of Deep Rock Galactic.) So please stick around and check for updates if the game isn't quite what you thought it would be yet. I promise that with a little time and excitement from the community it will become an indie game that I am proud to tell people I created.   



Thank you to everyone who has supported me!
